title: Io / Kīlauea patera
caption: USGS Kīlauea lidar provides the collapsed summit. Authored lava activity and simulated sulfur deposits change its identity.

title: Io / Krafla plume field
caption: Iceland ArcticDEM terrain, transplanted volcanic features, dark lava surfaces and procedural plume fallout.

title: Europa / Conamara scan wall
caption: Galileo stereo layout with terrestrial cliff modules re-materialled as ice. Baked relief and surface detail in the later game port.

title: Europa / ridged ice plain
caption: Terrestrial lidar graben layout and scanned cliff faces become bright ice plains, troughs and fissures.

title: Moon / Tranquillitatis pit
caption: Kaguya and LROC NAC measured relief surround an authored shaft and overhang based on pit measurements.

title: Mars / Cerberus Fossae
caption: HiRISE/CTX relief provides the fissures; transplanted scan modules supply the steep wall faces.
